Question 1 — shaded-fraction r2

12 points; 2.5 planned minutes; easy

Two of the five equal cells are shaded. Select all true statements about the shaded fraction \( p \).
  1. \( p = 0.4 \)
  2. \( p = \frac{3}{5} \)
  3. \( p + (1-p) = 1 \)
  4. \( p = 0 \)
  5. \( p > 1 \)

Question 2 — quadratic-function r2

24 points; 5 planned minutes; hard

For \( f(x) = x^2 \), select all true statements.
  1. \( f(0) = 0 \)
  2. \( f(3) = 9 \)
  3. \( f(-3) = -9 \)
  4. \( f^{\prime}(x) = 2x \)
  5. The function is linear.
